metadata.title: CIVITA Experimental Database Hierarchy
metadata.description: Defines the entities, identifiers, and scientific relationships of the CIVITA Experimental Database.

source_association.description: Every scientific record belongs to the literature source identified by source_id. In literature_sources, source_id is the primary identifier; in all other entities, it associates the record with its literature source independently of scientific parent-child relationships.
validation_rules: A submission contains exactly one literature_sources record.
Every record in the submission has the same source_id as its literature_sources record.
References between records must resolve within the same literature source.

literature_sources.description: Top-level entity representing one publication, report, thesis, dataset, or experimental campaign.

keywords.description: Searchable descriptors associated with the source or dataset.

material_batches.description: Material mixture, batch, or material system definition.

geometries.description: Reusable specimen geometry definition based on the geometry parametrization library.

reinforcement_materials.description: Reusable definition of properties for reinforcement materials.

reinforcement_layouts.description: Reusable definition of a reinforcement layout associated with a specimen geometry. Combines multiple reinforcement components into a complete reinforcement configuration defined with respect to the coordinate system and geometric parametrization of the associated specimen geometry.

reinforcement_components.description: Reusable definition of reinforcement components. Represents one reinforcement component, e.g., rebar layer, stirrup set, tie set, or external reinforcement system, associated with a reinforcement layout. Combines reinforcement geometrical information and material properties to define one component of a reinforcement layout.

specimens.description: Intermediate entity representing a physical specimen or specimen family defined by the combination of material batch, geometry, optional reinforcement, and optional printing variables.

tests.description: Definition of an experimental test configuration applied to a specimen configuration; the same test may be repeated, with individual repetition results or aggregate results recorded in data.

devices_and_supports.description: Support, actuator, sensor, fixture, instrumentation component, or measurement device associated with a test.

loading_histories.description: Loading protocol or loading time history associated with a test and, when applicable, with a device.

data.description: Experimental observation or dataset associated with a test, including individual repetition results and statistical summaries of multiple specimens; may contain scalar quantities, curves, tables, images, videos, and multidimensional fields.
